programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.desc: In this episode, Mark Peterson finds himself deep in the heart of Peru and focuses on completing the prestigious South America Upland Slam. With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. These West Peruvian Doves are known for their erratic flight patterns, often bouncing from one tree to another in a random manner, making timing and placement critical.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: With over 20 years of service, retiring as a Senior Chief Machinery Technician, Steven served abord multiple Coast Guard cutters, led critical missions, protected our nation's leaders, and earned the Coast Guard Achievement Medal for his outstanding service. Beyond the uniform, Steven has has spent decades giving back - coaching youth sports, mentoring young athletes, and living the values of service, leadership, and integrity. Steven's dedication didn't end with retirement - and neither does our gratitude. We were honored to have Steven at Thumbtack Ranch and are even more grateful for his service.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: From time to time you have moments that will change the way think about something. That is what happened for us while hunting the Scimitar Oryx with Republic Outdoors. Hunting is more than harvesting animals, it’s conservation, and in this story, we learn how a species nearly extinct gets another chance to live.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: It’s the opening week of rifle camp and everyone is ready to go. Big Hoss has a close encounter with a big eight point and Cody finds himself having a little Déjà vu when a big buck walks out into the same plot he killed in last year.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We love our members. We spent some time in camp with Ron Chandler. Ron Recently renewed his TTHA Membership in 2022 and was awarded a member hunt for 2023. We spend time reflecting on what hunting means to Ron and spending time in camp at G2 with hunters alike.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Rifle season is off to a slow start but things are heating up with lots of tags to fill.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa continues as he transitions from daytime stalks to the stealth of the night. In this episode, the focus shifts to one of the most elusive members of the "Tiny Ten"—the Cape Grysbok. Primarily nocturnal, the Cape Grysbok is a master of blending into the thick brush making it very difficult to get a good shot off. Hunting these ghosts requires a different set of skills and equipment, often involving spotlighting from the back of a Land Cruiser to catch the reflection of their eyes in the dark. Watch as Mark and the crew navigate the rugged Eastern Cape terrain under the stars, utilizing spotlights to locate their target.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Nate catches up with the Oklahoma buck that he had the close call with, and Cody is able to close the chapter with a buck he has been after for a few seasons.

programme.title: The Raven Project

He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is nearing the end of his trip to Slovakia and he has one more animal to hunt before heading back to Michigan--the Fallow Deer. It's October and the woods are alive with the roars of big, free-range rutting Fallow Bucks as the sun rises. This is one of the world’s best-kept hunting secrets, and Mark is about to experience it firsthand.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: If you had a blank check to build the best fishing boat possible, what would you create? Capt. Justin gets his wish, but it doesn’t come quickly or easily.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin takes a fellow guide on his new boat to see how it measures up. Using only public waypoints on his Humminbird unit, they find exploring to be as much fun as it is fruitful.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Melissa Bachman has made her name over the last two decades as one of the most dedicated hunters and producers in the outdoor industry. In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. First, we’ll head to Prince of Whales Island as Melissa tries to catch up to a giant black bear, then travel across the pond to chase mountain ibex, New Zealand for tar, and back to the states for whitetail.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.title: Kevin Nealon: Whelmed, But Not Overly
programme.desc: With his unique sense of humor, profound dry wit, and likeable demeanor, Kevin Nealon brings his jazzy cool style to “Whelmed… But Not Overly.” He's like a big kid as he delights in stories of messing with celebrities and embarrassing moments.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
programme.desc: A comedy set and travelogue by comedian Jeff Dunham as he and his ventriloquist’s dummies perform globally from Iceland and London to Israel.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
programme.desc: Join Jeff and his outspoken felt pals: Walter, Peanut, José Jalapeño, Bubba J, and Sweet Daddy Dee for an evening of laughs and observations.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
programme.desc: The ventriloquist comedian provides fresh, hilarious material with his favorite puppets; Walter, Peanut, and two brand new characters.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
programme.desc: Jeff and his felt friends Walter, Melvin the Superhero Guy, Peanut, and others share their latest and greatest thoughts about our times.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
programme.desc: The comedian and ventriloquist extraordinaire, along with this felt friends, visits a haunted house where hilarious chaos ensues.

programme.title: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas
programme.desc: Kansas-based comedian Chris Porter’s comedy set about men’s very limited emotions, people who think the Earth is flat, and hipsters ruining food.

programme.title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
programme.desc: Quipster Josh Blue hits the stage where he turns his cerebral palsy and cross-cultural marriage into comedy gold.

programme.title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign It's Finally Time My Last Show
programme.desc: After spending over four decades delighting audiences, the renowned comedian takes the stage for the last time in his farewell stand-up special.

programme.title: Doug Stanhope: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: The hard-hitting comic tackles mental illness, Vietnam vets and why his biggest competitor is ISIS in this show from his hometown of Bisbee, Arizona.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, And Blue Birthday Special
programme.desc: Jeff Dunham celebrates America's 250th birthday with Walter, Peanut, Bubba J and Achmed in a star-spangled comedy event full of patriotic mischief, where his crew may not understand the history, but they absolutely understand the sentiment.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: The 1980s supercar explosion sends performers like the Lamborghini Countach, Porsche 959 and Lotus Esprit Turbo peeling out of Europe; Detroit designer Jerry Wiegert enters America into the race with his jet fighter on wheels, the Vector W8.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: While the DeLorean is best known as the time machine from "Back to the Future," the true story behind the DMC-12 has more plot twists than any Hollywood movie; telling the tale of its inventor, John DeLorean, and his quest to create a new U.S. car company.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: The Pontiac Trans Am isn't just part of the muscle car movement, it's a statement and a complete package on the track or on the streets; a star of "Smokey and the Bandit" and "Knight Rider," the Trans Am pushes muscle cars to the limit.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: Before becoming America's Sports Car, the Chevrolet Corvette was the bane of General Motors' existence; when the automaker attempted to discontinue the line in 1983, a small team of self-funded true believers went rogue, sparking a civil war within GM.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: Hollywood gives audiences plenty of hero cars they can drive home, Knight Rider, the DeLorean, even Herbie, but the Batmobile is always out of reach; of all its incarnations, no other machine redefined the movie car more than the 1989 Batmobile.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: As the American military outgrows the Jeep, it needs something strong, tough, more versatile, and the Humvee is the answer; from Desert Storm to Rodeo Drive, it became America's vehicle of choice, courtesy of its big fan, Arnold Schwarzenegger.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: A garage-built experiment turns a cultural icon, the Meyers Manx dune buggy, which makes car building accessible to the masses; its success unleashes a flood of copycats that nearly wiped out the very garage that started it all.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
programme.desc: As people spend more time in cars, drivers crave the comforts of home; factory options like glove-box cocktail bars promise just that, though not all are created equal; join Jeff Dunham for a ride through the wacky world of factory options!

programme.title: Gary Gulman: Boyish Man
programme.desc: Last Comic Standing alum, Gary Gulman, delivers with his clever wit and handsome boyish charm. Boyish Man features Hanukkah vs. Christmas, all kinds of cookies (and crackers) dating, sex… and everything in between.

programme.title: Dom Irrera: Live From Las Vegas
programme.desc: Bringing his Philly attitude to the heart of Las Vegas, comedy legend Dom Irrera holds nothing back in this brutally honest and hilarious special.

programme.title: Andrew Schiavone: Central Nervousness
programme.desc: Andrew Schiavone's delightful awkwardness and charming worldview shine through in stories about dating, workplace mishaps, and first loves.

programme.title: Tommy Davidson: Takin' It To D.C.
programme.desc: Whether he's talking about sex, the national anthem, cockroaches or impersonating Michael Jackson, the triple threat is sure to make you laugh.

programme.title: Tommy Davidson: Illin' In Philly
programme.desc: This is Tommy Davidson, from "In Living Color", at his funniest! Check out this classic stand-up special and remember the 90s!

programme.title: Tom Papa: Live in New York City
programme.desc: With a shiny happy exterior, an offbeat, demented interior and direction from Rob Zombie, Tom Papa’s “Live In New York City” attacks our hilarious attempts at happiness as life piles up around us. He jokes about becoming a parent, family pets, and boundaries for technology.

programme.title: Taylor Hughes: Chasing Wonder
programme.desc: This unique entertainer fell in love with magic as a child and has become known for his signature style, that blends magic, storytelling, and comedy.

programme.title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
programme.desc: A stand-up special covering the everything from the life advice his parents gave him to people with no talent having clothing lines and more.

programme.title: Sinbad: Where U Been
programme.desc: Sinbad hits the stage hard as he speaks truth to the burning subjects of the day, from poverty and politics to where he's been keeping himself.

programme.title: Logan Guntzelman: Boner Technology
programme.desc: Logan Guntzelman shares the highs and (mostly) lows of pandemic dating apps, moving in with her boyfriend, and advancements in male healthcare.

programme.title: Jim Gaffigan: Quality Time
programme.desc: The comedian discusses why we aren’t honest about not wanting to attend events, lying to children, and so much more in this hilarious special.

programme.title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
programme.desc: The stand-up comedy star describes how his wife faced a medical crisis, and he attempted to hold down the fort for their five children.

programme.title: Jim Gaffigan: The Pale Tourist - Canadian American
programme.desc: Jim Gaffigan performs in Canada and has some very strong opinions on poutine, Saskatchewan, health care and the pronunciation of the city of Regina.

programme.title: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty, Sexy, Funny
programme.desc: Jenny McCarthy’s brand of naughty comedy gets a boost from popular female comedians, including Tiffany Haddish, on the realities of being a woman.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A Labor Day weekend turned into a nightmare of murder as a cross-country crime spree terrorized the nation. In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenage boy disappeared within hours of each other. Police believed the cases were linked, but didn't know how. They contacted the FBI for help. A trail of stolen vehicles and murder victims across seven states led agents on a hunt for two suspected killers. Their only hope of stopping them was to anticipate the killers' next move.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A day that began with a class field trip ended with a parent's worst nightmare. An 11-year-old girl was missing. Her parents were certain she was no runaway. When they failed to find her in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police. The FBI soon joined the investigation and family and friends worked with detectives and agents in an urgent search for the missing girl. Faced with conflicting witness reports and false leads, agents wouldn't stop until they found the girl, and the truth.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the summer of 1988, a wealthy Jackson, Mississippi woman disappeared from her home in broad daylight. Left behind was a mysterious ransom note listing twelve names and no specific instructions. The note, and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate. FBI and local police struggled to find answers in the cryptic message so they could find the kidnapper and retrieve the victim before her time ran out. Solving the crime required the keen insight of a criminal profiler and the perseverance of a family, local authorities, and the FBI.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Arizona, a shipment of money vanished into the high desert, along with the two men hired to guard it. The FBI didn't know if the guards were participants or victims of an ambush. Answers lay somewhere in the thousands of square miles of Arizona's northwest territory. When the vehicle was recovered with three hundred thousand dollars and the drivers missing, suspicions that the crime was an inside job grew.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Alabama, a pair of convicted felons escaped the custody of a local deputy and fled across the country. Eluding authorities, they moved from state to state in a wave of abduction and car theft. When a foreign military officer disappeared along their trail, police and FBI agents wondered if the armed fugitives had become killers. Agents believed the pair were growing more violent and raced to find the escapees before more victims crossed their path.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a young mother was gunned down in front of her children. Police searched for answers, but found none. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless, and random. Then, family members offered a startling clue. The victim, the wife of a prominent Atlanta attorney, was also a woman burdened with a secret; a secret the FBI believed led to her death. It would force local and federal agents to untangle an intricate web of money, drugs and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Memphis, Tennessee, a horrible crime terrified local residents. When a wealthy young mother was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The twenty-five year old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband, and several spurned boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list. To find the woman and her abductor, investigators would have to first determine the motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 80's, Florida's cocaine imports were among the highest in the nation. Regional territories were enforced with intimidation and murder. Desperate to stop the violence, local authorities turned to the FBI for help. One dealer bowed to no one. He would stop at nothing to keep detectives and agents from building a case against him. When his organization began targeting the government itself, a city went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Kokomo, Indiana an unthinkable crime terrified residents. A young woman was snatched from her home on a bright spring morning. Drops of blood and a torn window screen were all that was left to tell authorities what happened to the twenty-one year old victim. After several days of searching, a former FBI profiler narrowed the suspect list to one. Agents and detectives followed the trail across state lines hoping to find the victim before her time ran out.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In July 1997, a triple murder terrified residents in the nation's capital. In a Georgetown coffee shop, three employees were shot to death. Investigators could find no immediate suspects and no clear motive for the attack. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong, or an act of cold-blooded vengeance against one of the victims?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1986, a small crime free Indiana town was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. After an officer was gunned down at point-blank range, the psychotic killer led investigators across the Midwest. No one knew where the gunman would strike next, even as his tally of murders and abductions grew. The FBI and state police raced against time to rescue America's heartland from this deranged gunman, before he killed again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a gunman fired into rush hour traffic. The brazen daytime shooting of employees from the Central Intelligence Agency stunned the country. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political. The FBI was called in, but the nationwide search quickly became a far-reaching international manhunt. Agents processed more than 2000 leads and crossed an ocean in the effort to deliver justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her 10 year-old son was missing from his school. No one knew how it could have happened. Within hours, the boy's entire family was frantically searching for him. The few leads in the case quickly turned cold and the FBI was called in to aid in the investigation. The search by agents and local authorities would cover a thousand miles to expose the kidnapper and find the missing child.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On a summer afternoon in upscale Lodi, California, a 12-year-old girl is abducted from her home. Scores of police officers and FBI agents converge, determined to find the young girl before it is too late. When the kidnapper's car is discovered in a field near Lodi, police dogs, helicopters, and hundreds of volunteers are employed in a round-the-clock search. It would take a community united in concern for one of their youngest to find the missing child.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In rural Texas, 13-year-old is kidnapped on her way to school. Frantic to find her safely, her millionaire father calls local authorities and the FBI. As police officers and agents conduct aerial surveillance, the father drives hundreds of miles through the night to deliver the ransom cash to a drop that the kidnappers keep changing. In a final effort to save the young girl, investigators must engage in a dangerous firefight with five desperate criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In September 1997, a team of masked gunmen robbed an armored car facility in Los Angeles, and made off with $18.9 million, the largest takeover heist in U.S. history. An employee believed she recognized the voice of one of the robbers, and FBI agents began conducting surveillance on a former employee of the facility. With only one piece of physical evidence, a fragment of a vehicle taillight, authorities hoped to connect him to the crime, and locate his accomplices.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Lincoln County, Nebraska, a fugitive drug dealer engaged in a shootout with state troopers, wounding two of them, and eluded capture after a high-speed chase. Authorities immediately set up a statewide manhunt, connecting the fugitive to a murder in western Nebraska. A chance sighting led FBI agents to a second confrontation with the killer, who was more determined than ever to escape the law.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, FBI agents tracked him through his habits and addictions. They focused their investigation on gambling communities throughout the country and, when he resurfaced in Atlantic City, authorities used all of their resources to trap an elusive sociopath who claimed that he would never be taken alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1980's, a pair of serial bank robbers gained a reputation among law enforcement officials as formidable bandits. Using the same modus operandi, the two men took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest. After the criminals escaped from police custody, FBI agents familiar with the bandits believed that they would attempt a grand-scale heist. By conducting surveillance on known associates of the criminals, authorities tried to anticipate the next target.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the summer of 1999, Texas was terrorized by a brutal serial killer who traveled by train. The FBI assembled a task force to gather information about the dangerous drifter and create a profile that would help locate him. As they learned that the killer had traveled extensively through the United States and Mexico, the murders became more frequent, and authorities had to cast a dragnet over an entire continent in an effort to catch him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded. Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect. Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In August 1984, the son of a successful real estate developer was kidnapped in front of his father's business in Miami. After the father received a $3 million ransom demand from a self-proclaimed terrorist, the FBI became involved. Based on witness descriptions of the car used in the kidnapping, authorities began to suspect a pair of Colombian nationals with a known grudge against the developer's family.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In October 1995, a South Carolina family was taken hostage as part of an elaborately planned bank robbery. Local police quickly identified two of the perpetrators, but the criminal mastermind proved more elusive. After his escape from custody, authorities began to suspect the fugitive of involvement in a series of bank robberies up and down the east coast, and the FBI remained on his trail, hoping to catch him before he took more hostages.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Sandusky, Ohio, was fatally shot in his van. After discovering a night deposit bag with thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive, and began to investigate other possibilities. FBI agents learned that several motorcycle gang members had been stopped nearby on a traffic violation shortly after the murder and theorized that the clerk's murder may have been a botched hit carried out by a gang member.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a group of political extremists twice robbed a bank in Spokane, Washington, using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers, part of a shadowy organization called the Phineas Priesthood, might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement. After the suspects were identified, the FBI was faced with the task of safely arresting a group of terrorists with a deadly agenda.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent. The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts. When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1988, new light was shed on the mysterious death of a South Carolina farmer when a criminal confessed that two prominent community members hired him to commit murder. Local police and FBI agents arrested a wealthy businessman and later learned that, even behind bars, he commanded the power to corrupt and kill. Using prison informants, agents had to prevent him from murdering again.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In October 1993, a robber surprised unsuspecting customers by dropping through the roof of a California bank. When police arrived, he escaped from the roof in a hail of bullets. A tip from a local resident led police and FBI agents to the perpetrator. They would soon learn that he had masterminded a local kidnapping, and held the fate of an innocent woman in his hands.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Amid the cocaine wars of early 1980's Miami, three dead bodies led a multi-agency tactical squad to suspect that a group of cops might be involved in illegal drug busts. Investigating rumors of corruption, the squad uncovered a ring of patrolmen who were making millions by ripping off smuggled cocaine. The investigators set out to prove that even with the advantages wealth and the protection of a police badge, nobody is above the law.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A man is found suffocated in his Pennsylvania home, his checkbook, credit cards and vehicle appear to have been stolen. Fingerprints from the victim identify a recent escapee from a minimum-security prison, as well as his girlfriend. Investigators flag the dead man's credit cards, and are alerted when one is used in North Dakota. The FBI is called in and joins another task force already assembled because of a suspected kidnapping.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A New Jersey State Trooper is shot to death on the side of Interstate 80 near the Pennsylvania border. Witnesses to the shooting identify the shooter's car. Police issue an APB, and locate the vehicle hours later. Fingerprinting of the vehicle points to a fugitive wanted on bank robbery charges. Authorities who inspect the fugitive's home find some incriminating evidence including a box of bullets linked to the Trooper's murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1991, the Safe Streets Task Force, a joint FBI / Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Department organization, begins conducting an investigation into the violent activities of a local gang called the K Street Crew. Gang members are suspected of involvement in several area homicides. The FBI approaches several witnesses, hoping to convince them to testify against the gang members. Seven potential witnesses are murdered during the course of the investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June of 2000, two gunmen rob a Seattle, WA bank, and flee on foot as officers chase them. One of the gunmen is killed in a firefight with police, the other escapes after assaulting a family and using their home to hide. The family helps FBI agents identify the man, who is suspected of several other robberies. Seattle SWAT teams, working with the FBI, search the home of the assailant's mother, and find ammunition matching that used at the bank robbery.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's new sergeant Dan Scott (John Hopkins, "Poldark") arrives on the day after the murder of a local shrew occurs, and he is immediately put to work.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant, Day 3
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant continue their adventure in North Wales. Can Christina win the third leg in a row and hang on to her lead?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant, Day 4
programme.desc: It's the penultimate leg for auctioneers Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant as they shop around Warwickshire, Essex, and get treated to a spectacular Battle of Britain airshow. They then head for auction in Winchcombe, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant, Day 5
programme.desc: It's the final leg for Christina Trevanion and Thomas Plant. Starting in Gwersyllt in Wrexham, they meander through the border counties of North Wales and England, finishing up at their final auction in Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 1
programme.desc: Charlie Ross set Road Trip records the last time he was paired with James Braxton, but can he do it again? They set off from Boston and head to their first auction in the Norfolk town of Fakenham.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 2
programme.desc: In a Ford Zephyr, auctioneers Charlie Ross and James Braxton continue their hunt from the Lincolnshire town of Stamford, then travel east around Norfolk before ending up at an auction in the Cambridgeshire market town of St Ives.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 3
programme.desc: Auctioneers Charlie Ross and James Braxton are half-way through their trip in their Ford Zephyr. This leg sets off from Shenton in Leicestershire and takes them to auction in the village of Bourne End, Buckinghamshire.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 4
programme.desc: James Braxton is in the lead as they kick off in their Ford Zephyr from Rushden, Northamptonshire, which means Charlie Ross is playing catch up as they search for perfect purchases in Cambridgeshire, Bedfordshire and Buckinghamshire.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 5
programme.desc: Charlie Ross and James Braxton kick things off in Brasted, then journey through the Kent and Surrey countryside. Charlie takes a risky punt on a pricey purchase, but has he done enough to take the road trip crown from rival James?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 1
programme.desc: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst are having fun and chasing profits, from East Sussex to the coast of Dorset. Tim gets his hair washed while Catherine becomes a blacksmith.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 2
programme.desc: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst browse around Hampshire and West Sussex. But who'll be victorious at the auction in Hampshire?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 3
programme.desc: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst hit the shops, journeying from St Albans to Bushey in their safari-style classic car. Will antique biscuit tins prove to be profitable?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 4
programme.desc: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst visit Worcestershire, Oxfordshire and Gloucestershire. Tim unearths what could be a Roman coffin and Catherine phones a friend.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 5
programme.desc: A girl with some cherries lures Tim Medhurst to part with his cash, while Catherine Southon looks to a kaleidoscope for profit. Who'll reign in Wilshire and claim this Road Trip?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 1
programme.desc: Veteran Road Tripper James Braxton tours the southeast with novice Izzie Balmer, an auctioneer with a penchant for jewelry. Will she take the crown with her jewels?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 2
programme.desc: Izzie Balmer goes on a mission to Bletchley Park where codebreakers cracked messages from Hitler, while James Braxton dons a bandana and takes on English badminton.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 3
programme.desc: Izzie Balmer tries out a winter sport that began in the Fens. James is fuelled by the food of the common man. And they're buying chairs like they're going out of fashion for a Suffolk auction.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 4
programme.desc: Izzie Balmer and James Braxton visit the most easterly point. Izzie just can't resist the attractions of chairs -- Edwardian and Georgian. And James can't say no to a gigantic wine rack to go with his French cafe table.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a back yard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

programme.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
programme.desc: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team help Richard and Darren create a slice of New York's 'High Line' garden in Solihull. The garden has famously turned a disused train line into a thriving garden, mixing contemporary paving, grass planting and historical leftover train tracks.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Warrington, the team answer an SOS from ten-year-old Oliver, their youngest applicant ever. Bike-mad Oliver wants something that no one else has ever asked the designers for: a BMX track in his back garden.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team are in Leamington Spa to help Robert and Gemma and their young daughter Darcey. The family want a place where Darcey can come out and play without fear of falling into nettles or injuring herself on the uneven and broken patio.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Swindon, busy working couple Nicola and Anthony moved to their new house a year ago. They regard it as their forever dream home, the garden is letting them down and they hope to bring some Mediterranean glamour to it.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Jeannie and Norman have spent their retirement making the most of their long garden in Petersfield, Hampshire, but they want to turn an area at the back into a secluded, calm, Japanese-inspired 'garden within a garden' just for them.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's apple harvest time, so Monty collects some of his windfalls to juice, plants a shrub in the Cottage Garden and pots up amaryllis bulbs for Christmas.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is back at Powderham Castle in Devon, where she puts the finishing touches to a new herb bed. She prepares the vegetable beds for winter, planning for spring colour by planting tulip bulbs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants a rose against a shady wall and checks on the progress of his supermarket garlic. Adam Frost visits a plantsman's paradise at Fullers Mill in Suffolk as the autumn colour emerges.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants a hawthorn hedge in the orchard, prunes a climbing rose and starts to plant tulips for next spring. He puts his dahlia tubers into storage and offers some timely advice for protecting plants over winter.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After a busy winter, Monty plants up pots for early colour, shows how to move a clematis and sows veg for the year ahead. Adam Frost visits Ventnor Botanic Garden on the Isle of Wight. A gardener turned a concrete slab into her dream with containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty makes the most of the longer days as he continues the rejuvenation of his Jewel Garden borders. Joe Swift meets a group of neighbours championing their front gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north west coast of Scotland to the north east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty undertakes more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Arit Anderson meets a garden designer in Somerset who has worked in harmony with nature to create a garden on a former brownfield site.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don tackles autumn lawn maintenance tasks, Carol Klein is looking at burnets, and we meet a man who's dedicated himself to a North American prairie favourite, the echinacea.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nations most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty faces some of the most surprising plans yet - a Norwegian garden complete with waterfalls to be fashioned out of a tiny back yard in Dorset, and nothing less than a Japanese tea garden to be created out of a patch of ground in Bromley.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's full steam ahead at Longmeadow for Monty, who is busy getting the garden summer-ready. He is planning displays bursting with colour and scent, sharing some of his favourite foliage to create a tapestry of texture in shade.

He soon finds himself in the middle of the conflict, however, when a confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) captures the rancher and forces Kelly to help his soldiers steal a nearby herd of cattle, which they desperately need for food.

programme.title: Ten Wanted Men
programme.desc: Rancher John Stewart (Randolph Scott) prefers to to resolve problems without falling back on violent solutions. However, fellow cattleman Wick Campbell (Richard Boone) isn't so peaceful, and he hires a team of armed mercenaries, led by ruthless Frank Scavo (Leo Gordon), to rid him of any possible competition. After narrowly surviving an attack from Scavo and his men, Stewart has little choice but to fight back in order to save both his ranch and his family, including nephew Howie (Skip Homeier).

Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

programme.title: Jubal

Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

À Halloween, l'unité 118 doit gérer des événements étranges comme un accident causé par un conducteur sans tête, un homme persuadé d'être mort et un ballon citrouille géant. Parallèlement, Buck s'installe dans sa nouvelle maison et reçoit des signes du fantôme de Bobby, tandis qu'Eddie questionne sa foi après plusieurs phénomènes troublants.

Maddie encourage Chimney à accepter le poste de capitaine de la 118, malgré ses doutes. Lors d'une réunion familiale, plusieurs personnes sont grièvement blessées après un accident de tir à la corde. Athena enquête sur le cyberharcèlement ayant poussé Alicia à une overdose. Buck aide Harry à intégrer l'académie des pompiers malgré ses antécédents judiciaires.

Hen poursuit des soins dans un centre de bien-être pour des symptômes inexpliqués qu'elle cache à ses proches. Après plusieurs interventions, dont un accouchement d'urgence en forêt et un grave incendie, son état se dégrade et elle s'effondre en mission. Parallèlement, Buck et Ravi décident qu'Eddie a besoin de sortir en ville pour se détendre.

Athena pousse Chimney à se réconcilier avec Hen après son licenciement, mais leur discussion tourne vite à la dispute. Pendant ce temps, un nouvel assistant IA, censé faciliter le travail au centre d'appels, complique davantage les choses et oblige l'équipe à intervenir. Les proches d'Hen organisent une confrontation pour l'aider.

La santé de Hen se dégrade rapidement malgré le soutien de ses proches. En parallèle, Harry peine à terminer sa formation de pompier, traumatisé par les pertes récentes et la peur de faire souffrir Athena. Encouragé par Buck puis sa mère, il tente de surmonter ses blocages.

programme.desc: Céline est une cuisinière aux mille idées qui adore mixer le sucré et le salé, pour le plus grand malheur de ses amis. Au menu : du poulet trop cuit revenu dans du sirop de fraises et des pommes de terre à l'ail baignant dans de célèbres bonbons au carame

programme.title: Tintin et l'affaire Tournesol
programme.desc: Alors qu'un orage vient d'éclater sur Moulinsart, Tintin et le Capitaine Haddock constatent que des vitres volent en éclat de manière inexplicable. Le Professeur Tournesol semble en savoir beaucoup sur la question mais demande aux deux amis de ne pas s'inquièter. Tintin, Haddock et Milou accompagnent le savant chez l'un de ses collègues où il est enlevé par des espions à la solde de la Bordurie. R

programme.title: Un trésor dans votre maison
programme.desc: Et si un trésor se cachait dans votre grenier ? Dans chaque épisode, un particulier nous ouvre ses portes, convaincu de posséder une pépite : timbres rares, bijoux de famille, vase ancien ou vieil instrument oublié. Il nous confie l'estimation qu'il en fait et ce qu'il rêve d'accomplir avec cette somme. Rendez-vous ensuite chez un commissaire-priseur, dont le verdict expert réserve parfois de crue

programme.title: W9 boutique
programme.desc: Emission de télé-achat présentée par Pierre Dhostel et Valérie Pascal.

La 118 intervient dans un centre commercial lorsqu’une mère paniquée appelle pour signaler la disparition de son enfant. Deux colocataires se retrouvent ensevelis dans une décharge où ils cherchaient à récupérer un disque dur contenant des cryptomonnaies. Dans l’intervention, Chimney perd la bague de fiançailles qu’il venait d’acheter pour Maddie….

La 118 intervient lorsqu’une demande en mariage de haut vol est contrariée par le braquage d’une banque. L’équipe porte également secours à une future mariée coincée dans son carrosse juste avant la noce. Athena offre son soutien à une femme dont le mari vient de s’éteindre à leur domicile….

Toute la brigade d’intervention est sur le pont lorsqu’un accident sur l’autoroute entraîne l’effondrement d’un pont. Les secours s’organisent mais malgré les efforts de tous, les victimes s’accumulent que ce soit dans les rangs des civils ou ceux de la 118….

Ditari Pasdites
programme.desc: Ditari, hapësira informative që trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme, kryesisht politike, në 3 edicione qendrore. Analiza nga të ftuar dhe raportime live nga terreni.

programme.title: Rretheqark
programme.desc: ”Rretheqark” është dritarja që hapet çdo mbrëmje mbi botën në lëvizje. Në një orë, zbulojmë labirintet e gjeopolitikës, aty ku pushtetet maten, aleancat ndryshojnë dhe diplomacia shkruan historinë në heshtje. Ju çojmë në prapaskenën e ngjarjeve që përcaktojnë ekuilibrat globale e rajonale. Një udhëtim rretheqark , për të parë jo vetëm çfarë ndodh, por edhe ku po shkon bota dhe rajoni.\r\n”Rretheqark”, cdo mbrëmje në orën, 22:00. Nga Rosalba Bejdo dhe Xhevahir Qardaku.”.

programme.title: Edicioni qendror
programme.desc: Edicioni qendror informativ, hapësira informative që trajton çështjet më të rëndësishme te dites. Analiza nga të ftuar dhe raportime live nga terreni.

programme.title: Newsroom
programme.desc: Lajmet nuk mjaftojnë. Ndjekim faktet, zbulojmë rrethanat, çfarë thonë dhe fshehin shifrat. Sjellim historinë në NEWSROOM. Çdo ditë, nga e hëna në të premte, ora 15:30 në A2 CNN.

programme.title: Temp
programme.desc: Temp është një program 30 minuta për t’u transmetuar gjatë fundjavës. Merret me çështjet më të nxehta të javës që mbeti pas, duke përzgjedhur një personazh, një person që ishte në që ndër të debateve apo vëmëndjes së kësaj jave. Ai mund të jetë një politikan, mjek, gazetar, kameraman, shkrimtar, sportist apo njeri i zakonshëm. Mjafton që të ketë qenë njeriu që ka bërë lajmin e kësaj jave në politikë, kronikë apo lajme suksesi sporti dhe kulture. Pas një biografie të shkurtër kamera e ndjek perzo.

programme.title: Çdo Kënd
programme.desc: Në një botë të vrullshme informacionesh, ndarja e të vërtetës nga të pavërtetat, gjysmë të vërtetat apo dezinformi është misioni i çdo medie serioze, i çdo gazetari. Ky është misioni i ÇDOKËND, një program që në 50 minuta, çdo të premte në orën 21:00 do të sjellë në A2CNN përmes gazetares Merita Haklaj ngjarjen kryesore të javës. Përgjigjet e çdo pikëpyetjeje vijnë përme kontrollit të fakteve, përballjes së palëve dhe analizës. Do t’i shohim ngjarjet në çdo kënd. Do t’i zbërthejmë ato për çdokën.

programme.title: War Zone
programme.desc: Warzone është një emision që trajton konfliktet e armatosura mes vendeve në botë. Në fokus janë zhvillimet që vijnë nga të gjitha frontet, lëvizjet e trupave dhe marrëdhëniet ndërkombëtare. Pjesë e rëndësishme e emisionit është edhe industria ushtarake e cila është edhe vendintare në këto konflikte.

programme.desc: Hotspot, nga gazetari Armend Pire, do të sjell nëpërmjet një cikël reportazhesh Shqipërinë ndryshe, shqiptarët, punëtorët e thjeshtë dhe profesionistët e fushave. I ndërtuar mbi bazën e rrëfimeve unike, ku personazhet nga fusha të ndryshme tregojnë sukseset e punës së tyre, traditën shqiptare, mikpritjen si dhe mundin e përditshëm. Rrëfime ekskluzive dhe personazhe që vijnë për shikuesit në një mënyrë të thjeshtë të të rrëfyerit. Çdo të shtunë, në orën 14:30 në A2 CNN.

Teatri, kinemaja, muzika, trashëgimia kulturore dhe ngjyrat e një telajoje që na bën të reflektojmë apo të buzeqeshim. Me intervista të thelluara, jo, si një libër, por edhe për një libër që mund të na ndryshojë jetën, rrëfime të sinqerta dhe prurje origjinale nga artistë shqiptarë dhe të huaj, ”KULT” sjell një hapësirë të veçantë për reflektim, krijimtari dhe di.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Das Boot des Ehepaars Robsenn, die "Robsenn One" ist in Seenot geraten und bittet die Hammersley um Hilfe. Auf dem Weg dorthin rettet die Crew einen Mann aus dem Meer, Geoff Kershaw, der früher als Lieutenant bei der Marine diente. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Auf einer Patrouillenfahrt stößt die Hammersley auf ein Fischerboot, dessen Crew illegal kostbaren Trochus sammelt. Das Boot versucht der Hammersley zu entkommen. In einer dramatischen Rettungsaktion gelingt es dem Team in letzter Sekunde, den Taucher zu retten. Zu ihrem Entsetzen stellen sie fest, dass es sich um einen Jungen handelt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Während einer Patrouillenfahrt stellt die Mannschaft der Hammersley auf einem illegalen Fischerboot eine beträchtliche Menge Plastiksprengstoff sicher. Diesen Erfolge feiert die Crew an ihrem freien Abend an Land ausgelassen und feucht-fröhlich. Als Robert sich betrunken auf den Weg zur Hammersley macht, belauscht er zufällig ein Gespräch zweier militanter Umweltschützer. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Besatzung der Hammersley erhält den Auftrag auf Victory Day Island nach einem abgestürzten Helikopter zu suchen. Die Aussicht Überlebende zu finden, ist äußerst gering. Aber nicht nur das bereitet Captain Mike und seiner Mannschaft Sorgen: Auf Victory Day Island wurden in den Fünfziger Jahren Atomtests durchgeführt und die Insel gilt als extrem strahlenbelastet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: Noch haben Charlie und Sarah niemandem von ihrer Beziehung erzählt. Als sie gerade noch versuchen, sich vor ihm zu verbergen, müssen sie zusehen, wie der Chief in dem Restaurant zusammenbricht und stirbt, offenbar vergiftet... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Almost Paradise

programme.title: Almost Paradise

programme.title: Almost Paradise

programme.title: Sea Patrol

programme.title: Sea Patrol

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Zu ihrem 21. Geburtstag bekommt Bomber von ihrer Mutter ein silbernes Armband geschenkt. Spider begleitet sie an Deck. Ordnungsgemäß melden sie sich bei Buffer ab, der ans Telefon gerufen wird und nicht bemerkt, dass die beiden nicht mehr zurückkehren: Beim Entsorgen des Mülls verliert Buffer ihr Armband. Als sie und Spider danach hangeln, verlieren sie den Halt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Hammersley geht dem Notruf eines Frachters nach, doch als sie dessen Position erreicht, ist das Schiff gesunken. Mit Ausnahme des Seemanns Pearson wurden alle Crewmitglieder getötet. Er berichtet, dass Osteuropäer das Schiff geentert und die Crew gezwungen hatten, ihre Ladung auf den Kabinenkreuzer der Kidnapper umzuladen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Crew der Hammersley leistet Aufbauhilfe auf den Samaru-Inseln, als plötzlich eine Mörsergranate einschlägt. Mike erhält Order, die Verletzen auf der Insel Tampu abzusetzen, als Jim um ein Schlauchboot für seine SAS-Einheit bittet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Interimsweise übernimmt Commander Freeman das Kommando an Bord der Hammersley, die einem Notruf nachgeht, doch der Trawler reagiert nicht auf Kates Funksprüche und versucht zu rammen. Abgesehen von Problemen mit der Steuerung scheint an Bord des Fischerboots alles in Ordnung zu sein, so dass die Entermannschaft schnell wieder abrückt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Die Hammersley empfängt einen Notruf von Walsmans Yacht Enterprise. Die Angreifer werden in die Flucht geschlagen, doch Walsman scheint vor allem die Marine von seinem Gast fern halten zu wollen. Der Grund wird schnell klar: Als die Crew der Hammersley das Schiff der Angreifer aufbringt, erkennen sie auf einem Flugblatt Walsmans Gast. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Explosives Staffelfinale der preisgekrönten Serie. An Bord der „Hammersley“ sieht die Navy-Crew, wie ein Schiff in die Luft fliegt. Drahtzieher Ray Walsman wird verhaftet – doch der Milliardär kann fliehen. Das nächste Problem: Auf der „Hammersley“ schleicht ein Profikiller umher…\nDie Serie wurde 2011 nach Staffel fünf eingestellt.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: Nikki ist überglücklich als ET ihr einen Heiratsantrag macht. Er verrät ihr auch, dass er aus der Marine austreten möchte um sich ganz seinem Hobby, dem Korallentauchen, hinzugeben. Bald bricht ET zu einem neuen Auftrag auf, doch als die Hammersley überraschend auslaufen muss, ist er noch nicht zurückgekehrt. Kurz darauf macht die Crew einen entsetzlichen Fund. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Génies de la nature
programme.desc: Tromper pour arriver à ses fins, user de stratégies criminelles pour se nourrir et se camoufler pour survivre : les animaux ont développé des compétences surprenantes.

programme.title: Génies de la nature

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.sub-title: Come on down!" "The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: Snobbish and wealthy Joanna Stayton is living a life of leisure with her husband, Grant, when she falls off their yacht and suffers amnesia. programme.title: Arinjtë Buni: Viti i Ariut - Mbrojtësi i fshehtë
programme.desc: Kur Arinjtë Buni fitojnë papritur fuqi magjike, një aventurë e jashtëzakonshme i pret mes botës njerëzore dhe asaj magjike. Por fuqitë e reja sjellin edhe rreziqe të papritura. Për të mbrojtur të dyja botët, ata duhet të zbulojnë sekretin e një krijese legjendare dhe të përballen me një sfidë që do të vërë në provë guximin dhe miqësinë e tyre.

programme.title: Mbretëresha e dëborës dhe princesha
programme.desc: Papritmas, Shpirtrat e Akullt kanë pushtuar qytetin e qetë ku jetojnë Kai dhe Gerda. Ila, një magjistare e vogël, vjen për të ndihmuar heronjtë tanë dhe së bashku do të shkojnë në botën magjike për t’i shpëtuar të gjithë.

programme.title: Elefanti i Magjistarit
programme.desc: Bazuar në romanin e Kate DiCamillo. Piter, një djalosh jetim, vendos të kërkojë për motrën e tij të humbur, por më parë ai duhet të përmbushë sfidat e dhëna nga Mbreti, që në dukje janë vërtetë të pamundura. Vetëm kështu ai mund të marrë elefantin e magjistarit, i cili do ta ndihmojë për të përmbushur fatin e tij.

Wenn die Welt innehält – Natur im Aufschwung
programme.desc: Die Natur startet wieder durch! Von der kanadischen Wildnis über das urbane Amerika bis hin zu den Hinterhöfen Großbritanniens enthüllen Wissenschaftler unerwartete und verblüffende Entdeckungen aus dem Jahr der Covid-Pandemie. Dieser ehrgeizige und provokative Film erforscht den Silberstreifen am Horizont: Viele Arten profitieren davon, wenn die Menschheit ausgebremst wird. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Asien in der Klimakrise
programme.desc: Als Folge des Klimawandels werden bis zum Jahr 2100 über eine Milliarde Menschen in niedrig gelegenen Küstengebieten leben, 70 Prozent davon in Südostasien. Das nächste Jahrzehnt wird entscheidend für das Schicksal dieser Regionen sein. Denn um eine Katastrophe abzuwenden, braucht es schnell kreative Lösungen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Welt ohne Wasser
programme.desc: Wasserknappheit wird in vielen Regionen der Erde zu einem immer größeren Problem. Deshalb suchen Experten unter Hochdruck nach Lösungen, um eine Katastrophe abzuwenden. Die jüngste Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters im Gestein vor der US-amerikanischen Küste könnte eine große Hoffnung für die Menschheit sein. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Requiem in Weiss – Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Die Gletscher der Ostalpen sterben unumkehrbar. Während das Eis schwindet und der Permafrost zerfällt, laufen die Seilbahnen, Schneekanonen donnern, Touristen strömen. Die Landschaft wird neu geformt. Dies ist ein visuell eindringliches Abschiedsdokument. Wissenschaft trifft Emotion und stellt eine Frage, die uns alle betrifft: Wie verabschieden wir uns? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Er mag’s gern schwer. Und allein ist schwerer. Solo, ohne Sauerstoff oder Träger und vorzugsweise im unwirtlichen Winter zieht es Jost Kobusch auf die höchsten Berge der Welt. Eine Nahtoderfahrung bei der Besteigung des Mount Everest bewertete der 26-Jährige als „immens positives Erlebnis“.

programme.desc: Jak Jones sicherte sich den Titel bei den diesjährigen British Open. Der Waliser besiegte im Finale den Engländer Mark Selby mit 10:6 und feierte damit seinen ersten Triumph bei diesem Turnier sowie seinen zweiten Ranglistentitel insgesamt. programme.title: Fati i Ushtarit
programme.desc: Scott Eastwood, Colin Hanks. Gjatë Betejës së Ardenëve, në Luftën e Dytë Botërore, një kapiten amerikan mbetet i vetmi i mbijetuar i njësisë së tij, i bllokuar pas vijave armike. I plagosur dhe i izoluar, ai duhet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe aftësitë e tij për të shmangur trupat gjermane dhe për t’u kthyer në linjat aleate.

programme.title: Mundësia e fundit
programme.desc: Ish-ushtari i forcave speciale Jake Harris rikthehet në aksion kur ish-shoku i tij i armëve, tashmë terrorist, merr peng krerët e ushtrisë amerikane në një bunker bërthamor. Me kohën që po mbaron, Harris duhet të përballet me një ushtri mercenarësh për të ndaluar vjedhjen e kodeve bërthamore dhe një katastrofë globale.

programme.title: Nata e Djallit 6: Nga Bota e Përtejme
programme.desc: Gemma, një nënë e re që jeton me vajzën në shtëpinë ku është rritur, zbulon se mund të udhëtojë në botën e shpirtrave dhe të sjellë qeniet e mbinatyrshme në botën e të gjallëve. Kur forcat e errëta zbulojnë aftësinë e saj, ajo përballet me një kërcënim që rrezikon gjithçka. Kapitulli i ri i sagës horror ”Nata e Djallit”.

programme.title: Fati i Ushtarit

programme.title: Hipoteza e dashurisë
programme.desc: Lili Reinhart, Tom Bateman. Për të bindur miqtë se ka një lidhje, një studente doktorature nis një romancë të shtirur me një profesor. Por ajo që fillon si një marrëveshje e leverdishme, shndërrohet në një histori dashurie të papritur.

programme.title: Patrulla e Putrave: Aventura me Dinosaurët
programme.desc: Pas një stuhie misterioze, anija e Patrullës së Putrave përplaset në një ishull tropikal të panjohur, të banuar nga dinosaurët. Atje, këlyshët takojnë Rex-in, një qenush që ka mbetur i bllokuar prej vitesh dhe është bërë ekspert i botës parahistorike. Por kur planet e kryetarit Humdinger shkaktojnë shpërthimin e një vullkani, ekipi duhet të bashkojë forcat për të shpëtuar ishullin.

Telashet nuk kanë të sosur në këtë familje të madhe, por Reimondi ka mësuar si t’i përballojë ato.

programme.title: S9E9 - Zëri i Arsyes
programme.desc: Këto janë aventurat dhe telashet e komedianit Jerry Seinfeld, një aktor komik i suksesshëm në NY, i cili ndaj jetën e tij frenetike me miqtë e tij duke e mbushur të përditshmen plot humor.

programme.title: S2E20 - Single Me Dy Fëmijë
programme.desc: Pas përkeqësimit të Bonit, Marxhori, Xhill dhe Uendi i qëndrojnë pranë për ta ndihmuar gjatë pastrimit nga pilulat e dhimbjeve, por Kristi nuk dëshiron të marrë pjesë.

programme.title: Asi
programme.desc: Asi (Adriano Celentano) lojtari më i mirë i pokerit në gjithë qytetit, vritet pikëritsht ditën e dasmës... Tashmë, ai rikthehet në tokë si një fantazmë, për të gjetur një burrë të denjë për gruan e tij (Edwige Fenech) ...

programme.title: S2E4 - Coupling
programme.desc: Xhonatani kërkon një send me vlerë për një profesor. Xhorxhi dështon në një test droge dhe duhet të gjejë një alibi. Rei përballet me famën.

programme.title: Rimbledhja e Maturës
programme.desc: Federika vendos të organizojë një festë të vogël në vilën e saj buzë detit, duke ftuar të gjithë shoqërinë e shkollës, 15 vjet pas përfundimit të saj. ”Çasti i të vërtetës”, në të cilin dalin në dritë të gjitha aspektet negative dhe të hidhura. C.Verdone heq dorë nga ”personazhet robotë” dhe përpiqet të na paraqitet ndryshe me një film ambicioz, i cili arrin limitet e komedisë italiane.

programme.title: S2E4 - Grupi
programme.desc: Të gjithë në grupin e studimit, përveç Abedit, kanë ngelur në një stimulator hapësinorë të viteve 1980 ndërsa ai i drejtohet kampusit. Abedi e drejton ekipin duke u dhënë atyre detyra të vështira për ti kthyer në shtëpi.

programme.title: S6E23 - Teoria Big Beng
programme.desc: Kur planet e vajzave për një udhëtim në Las Vegas dështojnë, djemtë i ftojnë të luajnë Dungeons & Dragons. Loja sjell momente të papritura në marrëdhënien e Sheldonit me Emin, ndërsa Raj përpiqet të përballojë një takim të sikletshëm me Lusin.

programme.title: S2E4 - Një Shtëpiake Jashtë Rregullave
programme.desc: Kur Ana Kati sjell në shtëpi morrat, Keiti forcon lidhjen me Tejlorin.

C.Verdone heq dorë nga ”personazhet robotë” dhe përpiqet të na paraqitet ndryshe me një film ambicioz, i cili arrin limitet e komedisë italiane.

programme.title: S0E4 - Alo, Alo
programme.desc: René Artois ka një kafene të vogël në Francë gjatë Luftës së Dytë Botërore. Ai duket gjithnjë zënë me diçka: Ka histori me kamarieret e tij, bën të lumtur të shoqen, përpiqet tI bëj qejfin ushtarëve gjerman që frekuentojnë kafenenë e tij si edhe po drejton një operacion të fshehtë për Rezistencë.

programme.title: Disco 90 - Vazhdimi
programme.desc: Tano është një taksist në stacionin qendror të Milanos. Pa e ditur, ai merr në taksi një krye mafioz. Taksia ndalohet nga policia dhe Tano përfundon në burg, pasi e marrin për mafioz. Xhino dhe Graciela kanë një lokal në Ostia dhe janë lexues të zellshëm të gazetave që shkruajnë mbi skandalet e fundit. Një mbrëmje, rastësisht, strehojnë në shtëpinë e tyre dy njerëz të njohur, të cilët grinden për probleme dashurie. Don Buro është një prift fshati. Një prej banorëve i tregon dramën e jetës së tij. E bija është larguar nga shtëpia dhe është bërë pornostare në Milano. Për ta rikthyer në shtëpi Don Buro futet në shtëpinë e produksionit në Milano dhe hiqet si pornostar. Salvatore endet natën nëpër qytet, bashkë me shokët e tij. Ai kërkon një grua dhe se gje kurrë. Por një mbrëmje, një grua e mrekullueshme dhe shumë e pasur, e fton në vilën e saj. Për Salvatoren kjo është një ëndërr e pabesueshme. Por gruaja që ai takoi del se është mizore dhe sadomazokiste.

programme.title: Lindur me këmishë
programme.desc: Bud Spencer dhe Terence Hill, dyshja ikonë e viteve 60-80, që u shndërruan në një fenomen të industrisë kinematografike vijnë me filmat e tyre më të mirë. Dy njerëz, takohen fare rastësisht dhe një sërë ngatërrimesh identiteti, do t’i përfshijë që të dy në intriga ndërkombëtare.

programme.title: S0E5 - Alo, Alo
programme.desc: René Artois ka një kafene të vogël në Francë gjatë Luftës së Dytë Botërore. Ai duket gjithnjë zënë me diçka: Ka histori me kamarieret e tij, bën të lumtur të shoqen, përpiqet t’u bëjë qejfin ushtarëve gjermanë që frekuentojnë kafenenë e tij si edhe po drejton një operacion të fshehtë për Rezistencë. Shpesh është pikërisht paaftësia e ushtarëve gjermanë që e vë Renenë në rrezik. Ata nuk gjejnë mbështetje as nga personat e zones, të cillët edhe pse kanë një dëshirë të madhe t’i largojnë gjermanët, në përpjekje për t’I spiunuar krijojnë telashe që Reneja duhet t’i zgjidhë sa më shpejt.

programme.title: Lokomotiva e vjetër
programme.desc: Renato e Paolo vendosin të njihen me jetën moderne, por ajo nuk është edhe aq e mirë sa duket. Si fillim mundohen të gjejnë një punë, duke sajuar gjithfarë aftësish profesionale. Por çdo tentativë e tyre rezulton në një katastrofë të vërtetë.

programme.title: S0E14 - Familja Kuqezi
programme.desc: ; Bela i kujton Bertit qe kane nje dreke te vecante pasi vjen Maksi me Gerten. Berti merzitet ngaqe nuk mundet te shkoje me femijet ne stadium. Edi meson qe ne shtepi ka nje dreke speciale vetem me dy cifte dhe premton qe nuk do vije ne shtepi.

programme.title: Duar Të Mëndafshta
programme.desc: Guido është një inxhinier i suksesshëm, i cili është pasuruar nga shitja e xhamit të blinduar në argjendaritë e të gjithë botës. Kjo punë i ka siguruar edhe shumë armiq, por gjërat ndërlikohen kur ai bie në dashuri me Tilin.

programme.title: S0E5 - Idiotët e Përhershëm
programme.desc: Idiotët e përhershëm është komedia më satirike e televizionit italian që tregon neurozat, zakonet dhe traditat e ”njerëzve të zakonshëm” në një mënyrë groteske dhe shpërfillese. Një program televiziv plot ngjyra dhe shkëlqim, ku në rolet kryesore luajnë Frençesko Mandeli dhe Fabricio Bixhio.

programme.title: Krishtlindje 91
programme.desc: Christian De Sica, Massimo Boldi. Familjet shumëngjyrëshe, këtë herë do të takohen në një hotel luksoz në Zvicër dhe sigurisht që aventurat dhe situatat qesharake nuk do të mungojnë...

programme.title: Krishtlindje 2000
programme.desc: Christian De Sica, Massimo Boldi, Carmen Electra. Tre familje, secila nga shtresa të ndryshme të shoqërisë, vendosin të festojnë ndërrimin e shekujve në të njëjtin resort. Kekuptime, mashtrime dhe shantazhe do të kthejnë gjithçka përmbys.

programme.title: S0E6 - Alo, Alo
programme.desc: René Artois ka një kafene të vogël në Francë gjatë Luftës së Dytë Botërore. programme.title: Riki dhe Baraba
programme.desc: Riki një njeri i pasur që ka humbur gjithçka, ka vendosur t’i japë fund jetës. Por për fat ai shpëtohet nga Baraba, njeri pa shtëpi dhe pa të ardhme. Pikërisht këtu fillojnë edhe aventurat e tyre.

programme.title: S2E24 - Familja Kuqezi
programme.desc: Berti ka falimentuar dhe e ka të vështirë t’ia thotë familjes. Edi dhe Fatjoni do nisen për një udhëtim tre ditor në Gjermani, por Fatjoni nuk gjen dot paratë. Gerta ka vendosur t’i thotë Edit çfarë ndjen për të.

programme.desc: Kur Uendi merr vesh se ferma e gjyshes së saj është në rrezik falimentimi, ajo do të bëjë gjithçka për ta shpëtuar. Bashkë me ndihmën e shokëve të saj të rinj, a do mundet Uendi t’ia dalë mbanë?

programme.title: Një histori e re Hirusheje
programme.desc: Jeta në dukje e përsosur e një vajze, kthehet përmbys pasi një aksident sjell një djalë të ri në jetën e saj, i cili e ndihmon atë të zbulojë se kush është në të vërtetë...

programme.title: Kampi i baballarëve
programme.desc: Baballarët më shembullorë të qytetit do të vendosin të blejnë një kamp veror nga ku do të zenë fill edhe aventurat e reja të fëmijëve të kopshtit të tyre. Gara me një kamp kundërshtar do të vërë përballë provës edhe prindërit.

programme.title: Dymbedhjete
programme.desc: Kjo është aventura e një djali 12 vjecar dhe ëndrrës së tij për tu bërë një lojtar profesionist bejzbolli. Me ndihmën e familjes, dhe me shumë punë, ai do të bëjë gjithcka për të realizuar ëndrrën e tij...

programme.title: Lista e Xhesit
programme.desc: Edhe pse për Xhesikën të qënit e famshme nuk ka qenë kurrë e rëndësishme, ajo shndërrohet në vajzën më të kërkuar të shkollës... Por si?

programme.title: Vajza nga Avaloni
programme.desc: Ali, është e detyruar të shkojë në një shkollë të re, për shkak të punës së prindërve të saj... Por gjërat në këtë shkollë, nuk janë ashtu siç duken... Tani Ali, do ta gjejë veten të përfshirë, në ’Rimishërimin e mbretit Arthur...’.

programme.title: Përsëri në garë
programme.desc: Bazuar në një histori fymëzuese dhe të vërtetë. Pas një aksidenti automobilistik, Amberly, një kampione bote në kalërim, paralizohet nga beli e poshtë. Tani, për të rifituar vendin e saj në sportin që dashuron, ajo është e vendosur të luftojë me veten dhe të stërvitet cdo ditë.

programme.title: Kalorësi i stuhisë
programme.desc: Dani, një adoleshente e llastuar, humbet gjithçka kur babai i saj shkon në burg... Ajo do të mësojë se çfarë vlen vërtetë në jetë, kur shkon për të jetuar tek xhaxhai i saj dhe nis të kujdeset për një mëz...

programme.title: Vajzat e tifozëve 1
programme.desc: Mes vajzave të tifozerisë në shkollat e mesme të San Diegos ka filluar një garë e ashpër. Dy skuadra do të jenë rivale kryesore dhe Torrensi bashkë me shoqen e saj do të krijojnë një koreografi krejtësisht të re.

programme.title: I dashur ditar budalla
programme.desc: Kjo është historia e ditarit të Xhejmi Kellit, nxënëse e shkollës së mesme Makeral, dhe aventurat me shoqen e saj të ngushtë, Izabelë, armiken e saj, Anxhelinën, dhe djalin e ëndrrave të saj, Hudsonin.
